frozen_source.frozen_status: FROZEN_AUTHORED_STOP_V3_PHASE_CORRECTION_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW (the frozen STATUS.json is never edited; acceptance is recorded here)
frozen_source.frozen_digest_rule: sha256 of exact preimage file UTF-8 bytes, including final LF

acceptance.scope: Accepts the frozen source proposal, not installation, native cancellation, runtime behaviour or Event depth. Prior findings S-ISSUER, S-CLAIMED, S-FIRST-STOP-ACQUISITION and S-READBACK-RELEASED-IDLE are discharged; T-REPLAY is a nonblocking tooling advisory (correction C8).

placement.rule: Placed members are byte-identical copies at their package-relative paths; each equals its manifest entry and, where listed, its preimage whole_members entry. The four case-only duplicate aliases (coordinator/protocol.md, native-v8/protocol.md, producer-combined/protocol.md, replan/protocol.md) are not placed: a case-insensitive checkout cannot hold a path that differs from one of its siblings only by case, and each alias duplicates that sibling's PROTOCOL.md (replan's is that file minus its four-line Stop preface). The other preimage whole members (composition banks, inputs, originals) are not copied into this repository: they resolve only against frozen_source.root, each authenticated by its preimage sha256 before use. They are never resolved against canon, a shared checkout or a newer same-ID resource, and a missing or unequal external member makes installation unavailable, never substituted.

fresh_birth.rule: Only a genuine original Workflow birth installs v8. WorkflowBirth.writer_contract is the v8 constant; WorkflowBirth.installed_contract_digest and combined Enrollment installed_descriptor_sha256 equal the canon adoption digest in adoption-digest.txt. The frozen digest alone never authorizes a birth, because it selects the draft delivery profile (C1). No v3, v6 or v7 birth and no all_writers.stop_block.v1 birth is enrolled, upgraded, cast or late-enrolled; their profiles, keys, headers and generations stay exact.

descriptor.rule: The canon adoption descriptor is the JSON object adoption_descriptor below with canon_members filled by the source check; its digest is SHA-256 of the sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON preimage without prefix or trailing LF (CV-352 profile-digest rule). The frozen descriptor keeps its own pretty-printed-bytes rule. The two digests are distinct and never substituted for each other or for any v6 or v7 birth digest.

writer.rule: Method IDs are the exact frozen v8 identities; the draft. prefix is part of the frozen method namespace, not a status, and no method is renamed. The principal names the one Workflow writer that may append goal_run.replanned; every other route stays refused by RequiredOtherWorkflowWriterSource=false (EP-118).
